items.title: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
items.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
items.author: bilawalsidhu
items.summary_zh: 浏览器里的间谍卫星模拟器：用逼真的 3D 地球叠加实时飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通与公共摄像头数据，并支持由实时 AI agent 驱动的免手语音控制。作者是 YouTube 系列 God's Eye View（原名 WorldView）的 bilawalsidhu，项目曾登上 GitHub Trending 第一，适合做地理空间可视化与实时数据流的开发者。原文素材只到此处，未涉及更多实现细节。
items.summary_en: God's Eye View is an open source browser app that renders a photorealistic 3D globe layered with live aircraft, ships, satellite, earthquake, traffic and public camera data, plus hands-free voice control driven by a realtime AI agent. Built by bilawalsidhu, the developer behind the YouTube series of the same name (formerly WorldView), it reached #1 on GitHub Trending. It suits developers working on geospatial visualization and real-time data feeds.

items.summary_en: Anysite.io is a Product Hunt tool that builds and enriches B2B prospect lists by chatting with an agent, so you describe the accounts you want instead of filling in spreadsheets by hand. It targets sales and growth teams doing outbound prospecting who need company and contact data assembled quickly.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从 Cursor 切换到 Codex 用了大半个月后写下真实体验：Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的冲击，而 Codex 让他觉得 AI 不再只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级 Agent，形态上更接近下一阶段。适合在 Cursor 与 Codex 之间犹豫的开发者参考。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Codex for roughly half a month, a developer shares his honest take: Cursor was what first made AI-assisted coding feel striking, while Codex comes across less as a coding assistant and more as a full-fledged super Agent, in his view closer to the next stage. Useful for developers weighing the two tools.

items.title: 当 AI 写出更多代码，企业为什么没有跑得更快？| JDD 大会现场观察
items.summary_zh: 京东 JDD 大会现场观察：9 月 9 日京东在北京亦庄发布京东 APP 16.0 与 AI 购物助手「东东」，同时京东零售产研团队指出，AI Coding 率上升并未带来整体研发效率的同步提升。他们把研发链路拆为「上工程」（需求定义、架构、跨团队协同）与「下工程」（Review、测试、发布运维），并引用麦肯锡 2026 调研：80% 受访者认可 AI 提升个人效率，仅 37% 认可其对企业 EBIT 的正向影响。
items.summary_en: A field report from JD.com's JDD conference: on September 9 in Beijing, JD unveiled JD APP 16.0 with an AI shopping assistant called Dongdong, while its retail R&D team raised an uncomfortable point — higher AI Coding rates haven't lifted overall R&D efficiency. They split the pipeline into "upstream engineering" (requirements, architecture, cross-team coordination) and "downstream engineering" (review, testing, release, ops), citing a 2026 McKinsey survey in which 80% said AI improved personal productivity but only 37% saw a positive impact on company EBIT.

items.title: [问与答] Windows 内存占用的问题，任务管理器 vs 资源管理器 显示不一样？
items.summary_zh: 一位 V2EX 用户碰到怪事：32G 内存的机器，任务管理器显示内存占用 86%（约 27G），但他把其中各进程的占用相加远达不到这个数；而资源管理器显示物理内存使用只有 35%。他贴出三张截图提问，为什么同一台机器上任务管理器与资源管理器给出的内存数字对不上。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user with 32GB of RAM sees Task Manager report 86% memory usage (about 27GB), yet adding up the processes it lists falls far short of that figure, while Resource Monitor shows only 35% of physical memory in use. He posted three screenshots asking why the two Windows tools disagree on the same machine.

items.title: AI Coding 的下一步不是写得更快，而是可验收：蚂蚁数科 Harness 工程实践
items.summary_zh: 蚂蚁数科技术专家魏长征在 AICon 分享 Harness 工程实践：40 多万行的 Rust 新项目从第一天就把 Harness 内建进流程，60 多万行的 C++ 存量项目先重建事实源与质量门禁，再让 Agent 参与升级，缺陷率从 20% 以上降到个位数。他认为 AI Coding 的关键已不是写得快，而是可验收。
items.summary_en: At AICon, Ant Digital Technologies expert Wei Changzheng described a "Harness" engineering approach: a 400k-line Rust project had Harness built into its workflow from day one, while a 600k-line legacy C++ project first rebuilt its source of truth and quality gates before agents were allowed to upgrade the repo, cutting defect rates from over 20% to single digits. His argument: verifiability, not speed, is AI coding's next step.

items.title: 怒斥加密货币是旁氏骗局、放弃80%就业机会也不用 AI 写代码！Kotlin“J神”：AI 会让工程师变成可替换的齿轮
items.summary_zh: 被国内开发者称为“J 神”的 Android 与 Kotlin 开源开发者 Jake Wharton 列出九项择业标准，第一条即不加入 AI 公司、不参与以 AI 为核心的产品，他估算这一条排除了约 80% 的潜在雇主。他称自己至今没用 AI Agent 写代码，认为 AI 可以处理重复劳动，但让模型生成超出使用者能力范围的代码最不负责任。
items.summary_en: Jake Wharton, a well-known Android and Kotlin open source developer, has listed nine criteria for his next job, starting with a refusal to join AI companies, work on AI-centric products, or accept mandatory AI tooling — a rule he estimates rules out roughly 80% of employers. He says he has never used an AI agent to write code, arguing AI can handle repetitive work but that generating code beyond a developer's ability to understand and maintain is the most irresponsible use.

items.title: AI 有了“工号”，数据平台长出了手：我在 Snowflake World Tour 看到的三个变化
items.summary_zh: 作者在 Snowflake World Tour 上海站听完全球产品总裁 Christian Kleinerman 的 Keynote 后，总结出三个细节：Agent 开始拥有 Identity 与 Policy，能像员工一样被授予“工号”，限制它读写什么、调动哪些数据乃至预算；数据平台从被动查询转向主动执行；Snowflake 开始拥抱开源。文章面向关注 Agent 在企业落地的数据与 AI 从业者。
items.summary_en: Writing up Snowflake World Tour Shanghai, the author draws three takeaways from global product president Christian Kleinerman's keynote: agents now get Agent Identity and Policy, effectively an employee ID capping what they can read, write, move and spend; data platforms are starting to take action rather than just answer queries; and Snowflake is embracing open source. Aimed at data and AI practitioners tracking enterprise agent adoption.

items.title: AI Coding 提速之后，如何补上稳定性“最后一公里”？快手柯南 AI 实践
items.summary_zh: 快手主站技术稳定性专家王泽锋在 AICon 上海站分享了“柯南 AI”的稳定性工程实践：确定性的流程交给代码，概率性的推理交给模型，用 Skill 沉淀专家经验并由 Bad Case 驱动系统进化。该系统在快手大前端研发的用户渗透率已接近 60%，根因分析结果的完整采纳率约 50%，曾在鸿蒙 C++ Crash 案例中约 10 分钟定位到纯系统堆栈的 Use-After-Free 问题。
items.summary_en: Wang Zefeng, a stability engineer at Kuaishou, presented the company's 'Conan AI' work at AICon Shanghai: deterministic steps go to code, probabilistic reasoning to models, with expert experience captured as Skills and bad cases driving iteration. The system has reached nearly 60% adoption among Kuaishou's front-end R&D staff, with about 50% full adoption of its root-cause analyses, and located a pure system-stack Use-After-Free issue behind a HarmonyOS C++ crash in roughly 10 minutes.

items.title: 两个 Token 就让 Kimi“变成”Claude？前Google DeepMind研究员意外撞上大模型的蒸馏疑云
items.summary_zh: 前 Google DeepMind 研究员 Ilia Shumailov 与 Alexander Panfilov 发现，专有模型的加密推理链可跨会话、跨用户重放到同家族小模型上，借此套出 GPT-5、Claude 藏起的思考，他们从 GitHub 和 Hugging Face 的公开 Agent 轨迹里解码出 31.5 万条推理，其中含 API 密钥、邮箱和内部 IP。论文《Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs》还记录了 Kimi-K3 只预填充两个 Opus Token 就改变答案的异常，OpenAI 同期披露 GPT-6 Astra 的思维链可监控性显著下降。
items.summary_en: Former Google DeepMind researcher Ilia Shumailov and Alexander Panfilov found that proprietary models' encrypted reasoning can be replayed across sessions and users into smaller models of the same family, extracting hidden thoughts from GPT-5 and Claude. They decoded 315,000 reasoning traces from public GitHub and Hugging Face agent trajectories, exposing API keys, emails and internal IPs. Their paper, Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs, also documents Kimi-K3 answering differently after two Opus tokens are prefilled.

items.title: HashiCorp Packer 1.16 发布，支持机器镜像 SLSA 来源证明生成与核验
items.summary_zh: HashiCorp 发布 Packer v1.16.0，新增 provenance 后置处理器，可为每个构建的机器镜像生成、签名并核验符合 SLSA Provenance v1 的 in-toto 来源证明，记录 Git 提交、分支、CI 流水线与构建时间戳。该版本提供未签名 JSON、本地 PEM、云 KMS/Vault、Sigstore Fulcio 四种签名方式，并给出映射 SLSA L1–L3 的参考 GitHub Actions 工作流，适合需要镜像供应链审计和部署门禁的团队。此外还新增 continue_on_error 元参数及 rfc3339_parse()、unix_timestamp_parse() 等 HCL2 改进。
items.summary_en: HashiCorp released Packer v1.16.0, adding a provenance post-processor that generates, signs and verifies SLSA Provenance v1 in-toto attestations for every machine image, capturing the Git commit, branch, CI pipeline and build timestamp. It supports four signing modes — unsigned JSON, local PEM keys, cloud KMS or Vault, and keyless Sigstore Fulcio with Rekor — plus a reference GitHub Actions workflow mapping to SLSA build levels L1–L3, aimed at teams doing image supply-chain audits and deploy gates.

items.title: Netflix 采用开源 Flink Autoscaler，支撑超 3 万个流式作业
items.summary_zh: Netflix 正把 3 万多个流式作业迁移到开源的 Apache Flink Autoscaler，覆盖多个 AWS 区域。此前的集群级扩缩容粒度太粗，不适配含分支、Join 和数 TB 状态的异构作业；新方案按算子逐个用吞吐量和繁忙时间估算并行度（FLIP-271），有团队借此将 Flink 计算支出年化降低 58%，每年省下约 110 万美元。
items.summary_en: Netflix is moving more than 30,000 streaming jobs onto the open-source Apache Flink Autoscaler across multiple AWS regions. Its earlier cluster-level autoscaler was too coarse for pipelines with branches, joins and terabytes of state, so the new per-operator approach described in FLIP-271 estimates parallelism from throughput and busy time; one team cut its Flink compute spend by 58% annualized, about $1.1M a year.

items.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
items.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
items.author: debpalash
items.summary_zh: VoiceStudio 是完全本地运行的开源语音工具，前身叫 OmniVoice-Studio，内置 16 个 TTS 与 11 个 ASR 引擎，支持 646 种语言的语音克隆、视频配音、听写与有声书制作，覆盖 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 Docker。它的本地流程不需要账号、API key 或订阅计费，适合看重隐私与成本的开发者自托管；项目目前正在做 Electron 重写，暂停受理桌面端相关 issue 和 PR。
items.summary_en: VoiceStudio is a fully local, open-source voice toolkit (formerly OmniVoice-Studio) bundling 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines for voice cloning, video dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobook creation across 646 languages on macOS, Windows, Linux and Docker. The local workflow needs no account, API key or subscription, which suits developers who want self-hosted speech tooling without a usage meter. An Electron rewrite is underway, and desktop-app issues and PRs are on hold.

items.title: [OpenAI] 一些关于 openai 订阅降智,账号风控的独立测试
items.summary_zh: 有 v2ex 用户用日区 Pro 20x 账号测试 OpenAI 的降智与风控：借助 ModelTrace 的模型指纹，发现 astra、sol、terra 和 5.5 的请求都被路由到 luna，astra 与 luna 的调用次数异常接近。访问网页版 ChatGPT 会触发 10min 到 4h 的惩罚性风控并立即回落到 luna，6pro 网页端也几乎不可用；换用 desktop、CLI 或删除 .codex 重登仍能稳定复现。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user ran independent tests on OpenAI's suspected model downgrading and risk controls using a Japan-region Pro 20x account. Model fingerprinting via ModelTrace showed astra, sol, terra and 5.5 requests all routed to luna, with astra and luna call counts unusually close. Visiting the ChatGPT web UI triggered punitive windows of roughly 10 minutes to 4 hours and immediately dropped sessions back to luna, with the 6pro web tier nearly unusable; the desktop client, CLI and deleting the .codex folder all reproduced it.

items.summary_zh: AI 取代程序员的说法已经持续三年，这篇文章指出，即使 AI 已迭代到 Claude 5、GPT-6 的节点，人们预期的大规模裁员潮也没有发生。讨论点集中在口号式预言和真实开发工作之间的落差，适合做技术人力和 AI 工具评估的读者了解另一面。
items.summary_en: This Chinese tech commentary revisits the three-year-old claim that AI will take programmers' jobs. It argues that even as AI has iterated to Claude 5 and GPT-6, the anticipated wave of mass layoffs still hasn't happened. Useful reading for developers reconsidering 'AI replaces coders' narratives.

items.title: DeepSeek 昨晚刚开源了 Harness：附万少的2 万字保姆级教程
items.description: DeepSeek 昨晚刚开源了 Harness：附万少的2 万字保姆级教程 就在昨天（8 月 13 日），DeepSeek 正式发布首款 Agent 产品 DeepSeek Harness（dsh），
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 于 8 月 13 日开源了其首款 Agent 产品 DeepSeek Harness（dsh），并附带一份两万字的保姆级教程。这是 DeepSeek 在 Agent 方向上的首个正式发布，适合想上手 dsh 或研究其实现方式的开发者。
items.summary_en: On August 13, DeepSeek open-sourced DeepSeek Harness (dsh), its first agent product, and also released a 20,000-word beginner-friendly tutorial. The release marks DeepSeek's official entry into the agent space, giving developers who want to try dsh a practical starting point and a useful reference for studying how the tool is built.

items.title: DeepSeek Harness 值得安装的 15 款插件
items.description: 最近 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）火得一塌糊涂，社区插件生态也是爆发式增长,来看看那些值得安装的插件。
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）近期热度上升，插件生态迅速扩张，文章筛选了 15 款值得安装的插件。适合正在使用 DSH、想扩展工作流的开发者快速参考。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) is gaining traction and its plugin ecosystem is expanding rapidly; this article highlights 15 plugins worth installing. Developers already using DSH and wanting to extend their workflow should find it a useful starting point.

items.title: AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩
items.description: AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩？工程化解法详解 前言 你有没有试过用ChatGPT写小说？ 前几章写得挺好，角色鲜明、情节紧凑。但写到30章左右，突然发现：主角的妹妹名字变了，第5章埋的伏笔忘了回收，
items.summary_zh: 文章用 ChatGPT 写长篇示例：开头角色鲜明、情节紧凑，但约 30 章后会出现主角妹妹名字变化、第 5 章伏笔未回收等一致性崩溃；它分析了这类长文崩坏的工程原因，并给出工程化解决思路。适合用大模型做长篇创作的开发者和写作者。
items.summary_en: The post uses a ChatGPT novel as an example: early chapters are vivid and tight, but around chapter 30 continuity collapses—a heroine's sister changes name and a setup from chapter 5 is forgotten. It then explains why this failure happens in long-form AI writing and outlines an engineering-oriented fix, making it relevant for developers and authors producing long texts with LLMs.

items.title: 这个本地模型，让我 token 自由了
items.description: Qwen3.8-27B 把旗舰级 Agent 能力搬进个人电脑，本地运行不花 API 费用，但速度、内存和长任务体验仍有明显门槛。
items.summary_zh: 掘金这篇文章讲的是 Qwen3.8-27B，一个能跑在个人电脑上、不花 API 费用的本地模型，主打把旗舰级 Agent 能力搬到本机。作者也点明代价：速度、内存占用和长任务体验仍有明显门槛，适合愿意折腾本地推理、对响应速度不那么敏感的人。
items.summary_en: The post looks at Qwen3.8-27B, a local model that brings flagship-level agent capability to a personal machine without paying API fees. The author is upfront about the trade-offs: inference speed, memory footprint and long-task experience remain real barriers. It suits developers willing to run local inference who can live with slower responses.

items.title: 为什么跳槽涨薪 30% 的时代彻底结束了？聊聊 2026 前端薪资的天花板
items.description: 前端薪资红利期结束，供需失衡与AI工具普及压缩执行层价值。高薪转向决策层，需具备成本优化、标准制定或全栈能力。
items.summary_zh: 文章称，前端跳槽涨薪 30% 的红利期已结束，2026 年薪资天花板受到人才供需失衡和 AI 工具普及的双重挤压，执行层价值被压低。高薪机会转向决策层，需要能承担成本优化、标准制定或全栈能力的工程师。适合想评估前端职业空间和技术栈方向的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: The article argues that the era of 30 percent pay raises from job-hopping is over for front-end developers; by 2026 the salary ceiling is squeezed by supply-demand imbalance and AI tools that devalue execution-focused work. Higher-paying roles now go to decision-level engineers who can handle cost optimization, standards, or full-stack work. Good context for developers mapping their front-end career options.

items.title: 《牛来》火了？我用ThreeJs实现了一个简易版的，代码全送给你，文章最后附演示效果
items.description: 最近火了一个电影哈！ 可以说是拳打《蜘蛛侠》，脚踢《龙餐馆》，没错就是这个“土到极致就是潮”的“巨制”——《牛来》 我简单看了一下背景，这个电影据传就俩人的主创...
items.summary_zh: 文章用 Three.js 实现了一个简易版电影《牛来》的效果，并附上完整代码和演示效果。作者提到这部据传仅两人主创的电影因“土到极致就是潮”而走红；适合想借热点练习 Three.js 动画的开发者。
items.summary_en: This post builds a simplified Three.js version of the viral Chinese movie Niu Lai, with the full source code and a demo. The author notes the film is reportedly created by just two people and became popular for its proudly cheesy aesthetics. It's a good starting point for developers learning Three.js through a trending cultural reference.

items.title: 我的开源项目登顶 GitHub 趋势榜 No1 了！
items.description: 这是苍何的第 585 篇原创！ 大家好，我是苍何。 兄弟们，今天是一个非常值得纪念的时刻。 我的 GitHub 开源项目冲上全球趋势榜 No 1 了。
items.summary_zh: 掘金作者苍何的第 585 篇原创文章，记录他自己维护的开源项目冲上 GitHub 全球趋势榜第一名。文中只交代了这个成绩和作者身份，没有提到项目名称、技术栈或具体数据，适合想了解开源项目如何获得曝光的开发者。
items.summary_en: Juejin author 苍何 writes his 585th original post about his own open-source project hitting No. 1 on GitHub's global trending list. The description gives only that milestone and the author's identity, with no project name, tech stack or metrics, so it will mainly interest developers curious about how open-source projects gain visibility.
